title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: From formalwear on Bellarmine Lawn to student-built machines crossing a pool, these documented Fairfield rituals give the Stag calendar its particular rhythm.

cards.title: Dress Up for Bellarmine Lawn
cards.subtitle: September formalwear, dancing, and a presidential welcome
cards.notes: Watch the current student-events calendar for the September date, then confirm admission requirements and the announced dress guidance.
cards.short_summary: Known as Pres Ball, this annual gathering turns the lawn outside Bellarmine Hall into a formal student dance.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield says its president welcomes students to Bellarmine Hall’s lawn each September for the Presidential Ball.
cards.access_notes: Student eligibility, admission rules, timing, and weather arrangements may vary by year.

cards.title: Start Basketball Season With Red Sea Madness
cards.subtitle: A fall pep rally flows into a campus concert
cards.notes: Check FUSA’s current announcement for the performer, venue, entry process, and any student-identification requirement before attending.
cards.short_summary: Fairfield pairs basketball-season kickoff activities with a fall concert artist selected for the campus event.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield documents the FUSA Concert as a fall basketball kickoff featuring a pep rally, slam dunks, giveaways, and a concert artist.
cards.access_notes: The performer, venue, ticketing, and attendance eligibility can change with each edition.

cards.title: Light the Tree Beside Egan Chapel
cards.subtitle: Carols and holiday remarks open Fairfield’s season
cards.notes: Use the University’s holiday listing to verify the date and weather plan; arrive in time for the remarks and student-group carols.
cards.short_summary: The campus holiday season begins with a large illuminated tree and performances by Fairfield’s a cappella groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield says the Annual Tree Lighting Ceremony illuminates the large tree by the Egan Chapel Patio, with presidential remarks and carols from The Bensonians and Sweet Harmony.
cards.access_notes: The ceremony is seasonal; consult the current holiday schedule for timing and weather changes.

cards.title: Close the Semester at Clam Jam
cards.subtitle: Fairfield’s long-running beach celebration before finals
cards.notes: Follow the University’s current instructions for eligibility, tickets, transportation, and permitted items; arrangements can change annually.
cards.short_summary: Clam Jam brings students together at Fairfield Beach for an end-of-year afternoon of food, friends, and dancing.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield identifies Clam Jam as a long-standing spring end-of-year tradition held at Fairfield Beach before finals.
cards.access_notes: Attendance conditions, location, transportation, and ticketing are determined by the current event notice.

cards.title: Give Seniors One Last Fairfield Week
cards.subtitle: Friendship, service, reflection, and a final dance
cards.notes: Graduating students should consult the senior schedule early, since individual activities may carry separate registration or capacity rules.
cards.short_summary: The week-long farewell culminates the senior experience through a changing program that includes the Commencement Ball.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield describes Senior Week as a spring, week-long celebration of friendship, service, and reflection that includes a Commencement Ball.
cards.access_notes: The program is intended for eligible graduating seniors, and its activities vary by year.

cards.title: Put Student Research on Display
cards.subtitle: Faculty-mentored projects move beyond the classroom
cards.notes: Look for the current symposium program to identify presentation formats, participating disciplines, and any visitor-registration details.
cards.short_summary: Students publicly present research developed with faculty mentors across Fairfield’s academic community.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield says the Student Research Symposium celebrates student research projects developed in collaboration with faculty mentors.
cards.access_notes: Participation and visitor arrangements depend on the current symposium announcement.

cards.title: Pitch for Seed Money on Stage
cards.subtitle: Student teams face a live panel of investors
cards.notes: Consult Fairfield StartUp’s current call for teams and showcase listing for application deadlines, audience access, and event logistics.
cards.short_summary: Selected student entrepreneurs present their ventures before judges and a live audience in Fairfield’s annual competition.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield identifies the Fairfield StartUp Showcase as its annual entrepreneurship competition, where selected student teams pitch to investors for seed money before a live audience.
cards.access_notes: Team selection, awards, venue, and audience admission are governed by the current competition notice.

cards.title: Engineer a Way Across the Pool
cards.subtitle: Course-built contraptions meet a very literal test
cards.notes: Attend only through the announced course or spectator arrangements; follow pool-deck rules and leave operation to registered teams.
cards.short_summary: Engineering teams design machines intended to carry a teammate efficiently across the water without abandoning sound engineering principles.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield documents Walk on Water as a project in which mostly first- and second-year student teams build a contraption intended to cross a pool.
cards.access_notes: Participation is tied to the relevant engineering coursework; spectators should follow current facility and event rules.

cards.title: Open the Academic Year in Procession
cards.subtitle: Fairfield’s Catholic ritual gathers the campus community
cards.notes: Check Campus Ministry’s calendar for the current time, location, accessibility information, and guidance for attendees of any faith.
cards.short_summary: Students, faculty, staff, and administrators join a festive procession and community prayers at the academic year’s opening Mass.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield says its Mass of the Holy Spirit marks the academic year’s start with a procession of students, faculty, staff, and administrators and special community prayers.
cards.access_notes: This is a Catholic liturgy; current attendance details should be confirmed through Campus Ministry.

cards.title: Mark the Start of Clinical Practice
cards.subtitle: Nursing students carry professional values forward
cards.notes: Eligible nursing students should rely on program communications for attire, guest access, ceremony timing, and participation requirements.
cards.short_summary: The ceremony recognizes nursing students’ transition into clinical work and the values expected in professional healthcare settings.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield describes the Clinical Initiation Ceremony as both the beginning of nurses’ clinical practice and a commemoration of the values they will carry into healthcare settings.
cards.access_notes: Participation is associated with the nursing program; cohort and guest arrangements may vary.
